name: City of Charlotte & Regional Municipalities
source_citation: Draft profile: goals summarized from public priorities. Page citations have not been verified against the official plan.
mission: To deliver exemplary municipal public services, promote equitable economic opportunity, and build a connected, sustainable, and safe 21st-century city.
funder_affinities: Department of Housing and Urban Development

goals.title: Rapid Transit Modernization, Bus Fleet Electrification, and Safe Streets
goals.citation: City of Charlotte draft profile, goal 1
goals.description: Expand light rail corridor planning (Silver Line), transition Charlotte Area Transit System (CATS) bus fleet to 100% zero-emission battery electric, and eliminate traffic fatalities under Vision Zero.
objectives: Procure battery-electric heavy duty transit buses and depot overhead charging gantries
Implement high-visibility crosswalks, protected bike lanes, and signal priority on Vision Zero high-injury corridors
Secure federal New Starts Capital Investment Grants for rapid transit extensions

goals.title: Municipal Building Decarbonization, Urban Heat Island, and Urban Forestry
goals.citation: City of Charlotte draft profile, goal 2
goals.description: Achieve net-zero carbon operations across city fleet and facilities by 2030, expand tree canopy to 50% coverage, and mitigate urban heat islands in historically redlined neighborhoods.
objectives: Install rooftop solar arrays and microgrid backup storage on municipal fire stations and police headquarters
Plant 10,000 native shade trees along urban heat island heat corridors
Deploy building envelope retrofits and heat pumps in city-owned recreational centers

goals.title: Urban Stormwater Infrastructure, Creeks Restoration, and Floodplain Buyouts
goals.citation: City of Charlotte draft profile, goal 3
goals.description: Restore degraded urban streams (Sugar Creek, Little Sugar Creek), retrofit aging underground culverts, and acquire flood-prone properties in regulated 100-year floodplains.
objectives: Restore stream banks and natural riparian wetlands in degraded urban sub-watersheds
Acquire and remove repetitive-loss residential structures from severe flood zones
Deploy smart stormwater sensors to monitor flash flooding on underpasses
